caveat: This verifies the deployed parse-resume Edge Function behavior from the public functions endpoint using synthetic non-sensitive fixtures. It does not apply migrations, deploy functions, prove authenticated resume artifact save/delete, prove malware scanning, or prove production PDF/DOC/DOCX extraction.
doesNotProve: This does not prove uploaded files are malware-free, that PDF/DOC/DOCX parsing is production-ready, that raw data is removed from every browser download/export/provider log/backup, or that the workflow is valid for employment decisions.
skipReason: Missing Supabase URL or anon/publishable key. Provide SUPABASE_URL/VITE_SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY/VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.
